  "title": "recycleretention"
}

Package recycleretention removes the old items from the CephFS recycle bins of the cephmount driver and the Samba VFS module recycleplus. Both move a deleted item to \<bin>/\<space>/YYYY/MM/DD/\<path>, with the date in UTC. Nothing else removes the items, thus this service removes the day folders that are older than the retention period.

The service registers a periodic job in the jobs service of the same process. The job runs on each node that has the service, so enable it on one node only:

	[serverless.services.jobs]

	[serverless.services.recycleretention]
	bins = ["/mnt/doylegen01/project/*/.recycle"]
	retention_days = 92
